about: Game animation library for the VRoid characters. Kimodo entries (with a prompt) are generated on the DGX Spark by living/tools/kimodo/spark.sh and made game-ready by animate.py --library; keyed entries are animate.py's hand-keyed CLIPS. See the header of animate.py for every field. layer: upper plays the clip on the spine, arms and head only while the body moves, over its gait (the game's anim.rs); without it, or standing, the whole body plays it.

clips.prompt: a person stands still in a relaxed neutral pose, arms hanging at the sides

clips.name: idle
clips.prompt: a person stands idle, breathing calmly and shifting weight slightly

clips.name: idle_look
clips.prompt: a person stands and looks around curiously

clips.name: gather

clips.note: town life: gathering at a field, a garden or a fishing spot

clips.name: work
clips.prompt: a person stands at a table kneading dough with both hands, pressing and folding it over and over without pausing
clips.note: town life: keeping a stall or a workshop door, cooking, tending. Clip lab 2026-11-11: kneading at a table; s22 has both hands busy 67% and some hand moving 86% of the clip (the old s2: 47%)

clips.name: eat
clips.prompt: a person stands and eats a piece of bread held in the right hand, taking small bites
clips.note: town life

clips.name: play
clips.prompt: a child jumps on the spot twice with both feet, laughing and waving the arms
clips.note: town life: children at play. Clip lab 2026-11-11, dev-box verdict (several hops or skips): s21 hops three times (0.37 s in the air at the longest) in 4 s; toe tips 2.2 cm under the floor at a landing (limit 2.0). No take of 64 (5 prompts, 4 and 6 s) hopped three times within the floor limit; s34 (two hops, 1.3 cm) is the floor-safe alternative

clips.name: sit_ground_pose
clips.prompt: a person sits upright on the ground with legs crossed, back straight, hands resting on the knees
clips.note: the seated pose (frame 45) that sit_ground_down ends in, sit_ground loops on and stand_up_ground starts from, as stand#3@45 is the standing one. Clip lab 2026-11-11, after dev-box asked for a more upright seat: torso -1.2 degrees from vertical (standing: -2; the old seat s0: +8.7 hunched, head 27.5 down), head 13.6, ankles 7.1 cm up, hands on the knees

clips.name: sit_ground_down
clips.prompt: a person sits down cross-legged on the ground and rests the hands on the knees, back straight
clips.note: town life: resting in the square or at the inn; ends in sit_ground_pose#1@45, the upright seat dev-box asked for, 0.4 m behind where it started. Clip lab 2026-11-11: s100 sits down with the hands never on the floor (the old s0: fingers 8.9 cm under it), feet slide 3.9 cm/s p90; fails one check: toe tips 2.5 cm under the floor (limit 2.0), the least of 40 takes into this seat

clips.name: sit_ground
clips.prompt: a person sitting cross-legged on the ground waves to a friend on the left, then turns to look at a friend on the right and laughs, leaning back and forth
clips.note: town life; loops on sit_ground_pose#1@45 (offset: sit_ground_down's end_offset). Clip lab 2026-11-11, after dev-box asked for a live, upright seat: 8 s; a hand or the head moves 65 % of the time, never still, the head turns 41 degrees, the shoulders move 16 cm, torso +1.9 degrees from vertical (the old s0: 11 %, still 4.4 s, 1 degree, 0.6 cm, hunched +8.7, head 27.5 down). Fails one check: the ankles dip to 4.3 cm (the seat: 7.1) as the legs shift; every one of 104 takes did, by 3-5 cm

clips.name: stand_up_ground
clips.prompt: a person sitting cross-legged on the ground rocks forward onto the feet and stands up
clips.note: town life: a sitter gets up before walking; starts in sit_ground_pose#1@45 and stands up over the origin. Clip lab 2026-11-11: from the upright seat dev-box asked for, s109 rocks forward onto the feet and stands; palms at most 0.9 cm under the floor, slide 5.2 cm/s p90, drift 2.1 cm (the old s0: knuckles 3.4 cm under, 9.0 cm/s, 7.3 cm); Kimodo's relaxed fingertips touch 6.8 cm through the floor, for the retarget to bend

clips.name: sword_slash
clips.prompt: a person swings a one-handed sword in a fast diagonal slash from the right shoulder down to the left hip

clips.name: sword_overhead
clips.prompt: a person raises a one-handed sword high above the head and strikes down hard in front

clips.name: sword_thrust
clips.prompt: a person thrusts a sword forward with the right hand

clips.name: block
clips.prompt: a person quickly raises the left forearm in front of the face to block a blow, then lowers it

clips.name: dodge
clips.prompt: a person dodges with a quick low dash forward, then recovers to standing
clips.note: combat: the rules dash 2.6 m at 5.2 m/s (dodge_dist, dodge_speed); the hips follow that track (2.72 SOMA m is 2.6 game m at k_game 0.956), and travel: path takes exactly it out (planted feet pinned along it), so the body's own motion carries the dash

clips.name: hit
clips.prompt: a person is hit in the chest and staggers back

clips.name: death
clips.prompt: a person is struck, collapses where they stand and falls to the ground, dead
clips.note: the hips stay over the origin (path), so the body falls where it stands. Laptop verdict 2026-11-12: s0 snapped in the raw take (left hand 128.5 degrees in one frame at f53, left thigh and foot 46-50 at f60; plant:false, so nothing downstream removes it). s4: no joint turns more than 7.8 degrees in a frame (s1 27.0, s2 76.7, s3 10.2, s5 19.1), pop 1.2 m/s (s0 6.65). It collapses forward from 0.9 s onto its knees and ends face down over folded knees, hips 37 cm up, still from 1.9 s. Every take fails the floor: s4's right knee 7.5 cm and toes 4.5 cm under (s0: body 21.9 cm); s4's planted feet slide 8.8 cm/s (limit 6). s1 is the alternative that ends lying flat (hips 19 cm), with a 27 degree step at f76

clips.name: cast
clips.prompt: a person casts a spell, thrusting both hands forward

clips.name: attack
clips.note: hand-keyed: an in-place guard, strike, guard loop for repeated swings; the Kimodo sword clips are one-shots from the neutral pose

clips.name: bow_shoot
clips.prompt: a person draws a bow and shoots an arrow

clips.name: turn_left_90
clips.prompt: a person turns 90 degrees to the left on the spot in two steps
clips.note: two steps (left, then right), no overshoot; ends facing 90 degrees left in the neutral pose, so no ease out to the forward-facing neutral

clips.name: turn_right_90
clips.prompt: a person turns 90 degrees to the right on the spot in two steps
clips.note: two steps (right, then left); ends facing 90 degrees right in the neutral pose

clips.name: turn_left_180
clips.prompt: a person turns around to the left on the spot, stepping left, right, left
clips.note: three steps (left, right, left); the hips' heading is pinned to a steady turn from 0.3 s to 1.7 s. Clip lab 2026-11-11: the old s4 slid (planted feet 6.3 cm/s p90) and s3 took four steps; s25 (the prompt names the steps) passes every check: LRL, toes 0.4 cm under the floor at most, slide 4.7 cm/s

clips.name: turn_right_180
clips.prompt: a person turns around to the right on the spot in three steps
clips.note: three steps (right, left, right); the hips' heading is pinned to a steady turn from 0.3 s to 1.7 s

clips.name: walk_start
clips.prompt: a person standing still starts walking forward, stepping off with the right foot
clips.note: right step, left step, ends as the left heel comes down in walk#1's frame 100 (half a cycle after the loop's start) at walk#1's speed; the hips follow the path (0 to 1.536 m/s between 0.15 s and 0.95 s)

clips.name: walk_stop
clips.prompt: a person walking forward stops abruptly in one step and stands still
clips.note: starts in walk#1's frame 83 at walk#1's speed. Laptop verdict 2026-11-11 (the authority stops a body where it is): stops within 0.27 m, one braking step, then the neutral pose. Fails one check: planted feet slide 8.4 cm/s p90 while braking (limit 6)

clips.name: run_start
clips.prompt: a person standing still starts running forward, pushing off with the right foot first
clips.note: right, left, right; ends as the right foot comes down in run#1's frame 91 (the loop's start) at run#1's speed. Seeds 0, 1, 3, 4, 5 step off with the left foot

clips.name: run_stop
clips.prompt: a person running forward stops abruptly, braking hard in one step, and stands still
clips.note: starts in run#1's frame 91 at run#1's speed. Laptop verdict 2026-11-11: stops within 0.42 m (0.3 s of braking), then the neutral pose; passes every check

clips.name: jump_stand
clips.prompt: a person jumps high straight up on the spot and lands
clips.note: Clip lab 2026-11-11: the hips rise 46 cm and both feet are off the ground 0.57 s (asked: 0.45 m, about 0.6 s); the old s4: 38 cm, 0.47 s. A tuck jump (knees pulled up, feet clear 91 cm) with the arms up, not a small hop. Fails slide only: planted feet 8.0 cm/s p90 at the landing (limit 6)

clips.name: jump_stand_hop
clips.prompt: a person jumps straight up on the spot and lands
clips.note: the first jump_stand, kept for the laptop to judge against jump_stand's tuck jump: in the air 0.63-1.10 s (0.47 s); the hips rise 0.38 m and the feet clear 0.27 m, less than the 0.45 m asked

clips.name: jump_forward
clips.prompt: a person running forward leaps forward over a gap, lands and keeps walking
clips.note: Laptop verdict 2026-11-11: a run-up at run#1's speed, the rules' hop path, landing into the rules' walk (2.6 m/s game, 2.72 SOMA). s26 leaps but early and long: in the air 0.63-1.27 s against the hop window 0.95-1.394 s (overlap 0.42); feet planted after it (slide 3.9 cm/s). A walking run-up never left the ground (16 takes)

clips.name: jump_forward_run

clips.note: Laptop verdict 2026-11-11: a leap that lands into the rules' run (3.9 m/s game, 4.08 SOMA): in the air 0.40 s, hop window overlap 0.90; fails one check: the chest swings 16 degrees off ahead in the air (limit 15)

clips.name: walk_back
clips.prompt: a person walks backward, looking straight ahead, arms swinging lightly
clips.note: cycle 1.10 s (x1.03 of walk#1) at 1.1 m/s: 1.22 m a cycle against walk#1's 1.70 m; hips ahead within 3 degrees; toe ends 1.8 cm under the floor at push-off (11 frames). Seeds 2 and 5 are cleaner on the floor at a 1.0 s and 0.97 s cycle

clips.name: run_back

clips.note: a backward jog: cycle 0.73 s (x1.05 of run#1) at 2.0 m/s, 1.47 m a cycle against run#1's 2.30 m; almost no flight Clip lab 2026-11-11: re-picked s2 -> s3: s2's planted feet slide 10.1 cm/s p90 (gait limit 10), s3's 9.2; s3's chest drifts 6.0 degrees (s2: 2.9)

clips.name: strafe_walk_left
clips.prompt: a person does a step touch to the left, over and over, arms relaxed at the sides
clips.note: a step touch: the only seed of 8 whose feet never cross (heels 9.5 to 77 cm apart). Slower than the walk: cycle 1.40 s (x1.31 of walk#1) at 0.46 m/s, 0.64 m a cycle. The relaxed-arm side-step prompts all crossed the trailing foot behind Laptop verdict 2026-11-11: a fallback only; strafe_walk_cross_left is the default sideways walk (the client adjusts the cadence). The clip lab found no take at the walk's cadence whose feet do not cross (48 more takes).

clips.name: strafe_walk_right

clips.note: a step touch, feet never cross (heels 4 to 76 cm apart); cycle 1.53 s (x1.44 of walk#1) at 0.44 m/s, 0.69 m a cycle. Seed 0 has the walk's cadence (1.13 s) and no crossing, but its chest turns up to 16 degrees and the arms lift Laptop verdict 2026-11-11: a fallback only; strafe_walk_cross_right is the default sideways walk (the client adjusts the cadence).

clips.name: jump_back

clips.name: jump_left

clips.name: walk_v26
clips.prompt: a person strides forward quickly, in a hurry
clips.note: Speed takes 2026-11-12: the forward walk made at the rules' 2.6 m/s (path 2.72 m/s raw: 2.6 over Vivi's 0.955 game metres a raw metre). s37: a true walk (never both feet up), period 0.744 s, 2.02 m a cycle raw (1.93 on Vivi; walk_brisk 2.03), slower toe 3.8 % of the body's speed (line 5), toes 1.7 cm under at most. 6 of 62 takes pass every check as a walk; 21 takes jogged (both feet up 4-27 % of the time, most with the arms raised) and were ruled out by air_share<=0.03

clips.name: run_v48
clips.prompt: a person runs forward fast with long strides
clips.note: Speed takes 2026-11-12: the forward run for the rules' 4.8 m/s, made at Kimodo's clean ceiling, 3.8 m/s raw (3.63 on Vivi): bake it with --target run_v48=4.8 (time scale about 1.32). At the 5.03 m/s raw that 4.8 needs, 0 of 74 takes keep their feet (slower toe 9-55 % of the body's speed, hips bounding 20-140 cm; scores in run_v48_raw503); at 4.0 raw 0 of 40, at 3.8 raw 6 of 24. s0: period 0.738 s, 2.80 m a cycle raw (2.68 on Vivi, run_fast's), slower toe 4.3 % (line 5), toes 1.1 cm under at most; fails loop velocity at its best cycle (0.63 m/s, limit 0.6; run#1 0.61, run_fast#1 0.87). Unpinned, Kimodo's fast run levels off at 3.5-3.7 m/s raw (run_fast#1)
